title: Storyboard Artist
subtitle: Turns a story into a shot-by-shot plan with timing, camera moves, the few lines of on-screen text and how each shot will be made.
lede: Turns a story into a shot-by-shot plan with timing, camera moves, the few lines of on-screen text and how each shot will be made. It folds every round of notes back into the same plan.
